the clip (as INPUT)
a folder, or one file per frame: key.####.exr, key.%04d.exr, key.$F4.exr

the first frame to write [default: the shot's first]

alpha, fg, cutout, checker, comma-separated [default: alpha,fg]

trust in the hint [default: 0.95]

trust in the carried hint [default: 0.95]
one phase's networks at a time (less graphics memory, slower)
EXR sequences, or videos (whole shots only) [default: exr]

despill strength [default: 0.5]
a video cutout in linear light

graphics memory this job may use [default: what is free]

the plates' colour space (EXR and image sequences)
the EXR outputs' colour space [default: the input's]
8 reads as CorridorKey 2.0 does; 16 keeps a deep source's bits [default: 8]
warm-up frames keyed before the range and never written [default: 0]

the engine's every reply on stderr too
stderr: failures only
